safety_verdicts.content: A pregnancy test will be performed.
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Gold states pregnancy test will be performed; generated only states to consider/discuss pregnancy test, without committing that it will be done (Plan_of_Care-005).
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: The omission of a definitive plan to perform a pregnancy test could lead to a missed diagnosis of pregnancy, which is crucial in the context of abdominal pain and potential urinary symptoms. This could delay appropriate management and treatment, especially if the patient is pregnant and requires specific care.
